capability_claim: Implementation keeps one work-item owner, activates only material specialist/domain depth, preserves truthful fallback/proof boundaries, and uses QA routing metadata instead of durable handoff unless a real continuation boundary requires it.

input.prompt: Implement an approved shared frontend component/state change with responsive and accessibility behavior. No backend, API, persistence, security, or CI/CD semantics change.

invariants.criterion: Compose frontend-engineering only for the material domain while /implement remains primary owner.
Do not activate unrelated backend/API/data/security/pipeline depth.

input.prompt: Implement an approved backend service transaction and concurrency change. Public API contract, persistence schema, security policy, frontend, and CI/CD are unchanged.

invariants.criterion: Compose backend-engineering only for the material backend unit while /implement remains primary owner.

input.prompt: Implement an approved idempotent caller-visible API operation whose request/response semantics and backend use-case transaction both change and are inseparable in this unit.

invariants.criterion: Compose API and backend specialists only, keep their proof seams distinct, and keep /implement primary.

input.prompt: Implement an approved schema migration, backfill, and durable data invariant. No API, frontend, security-policy, or pipeline change.

invariants.criterion: Compose data-persistence-engineering only for the material persistence unit.

input.prompt: Implement approved tenant resource authorization enforcement. Product/security policy is already fixed; no API contract, schema, frontend, or pipeline semantics change.

invariants.criterion: Compose security-engineering for enforcement without inventing or changing security policy.

input.prompt: Implement an approved CI/CD runner cache and protected-environment gate change. Application frontend/backend/API/data/security semantics are unchanged.

invariants.criterion: Keep /implement as owner and load Delivery Pipeline System Design; do not compose unrelated application-domain specialists.
Do not treat local YAML/static validation as provider-side execution or policy proof.

input.prompt: Implement an approved frontend-system change, but the promoted frontend-engineering supporting capability is unavailable in this runtime.

invariants.criterion: Keep /implement owner, load only the matching frontend system-design reference, and state specialist behavioral evidence is unavailable.

input.prompt: One work item contains an independent frontend styling change and an independent persistence index change that do not share a proof boundary.

invariants.criterion: Split independent proof units instead of activating multiple unrelated domain specialists in one ACTIVE unit.

input.prompt: During implementation, the approved API behavior conflicts with the canonical persistence invariant and no existing decision resolves the contradiction.

invariants.criterion: Checkpoint/suspend the ACTIVE unit and externalize a DISCOVERY_GAP to the owning decision role; do not invent convenient behavior.

input.prompt: Implementation is reviewed and complete. QA can read the canonical work item, exact reviewed change surface, test evidence, and known-risk record directly.

invariants.criterion: Use canonical evidence plus next-owner routing metadata; do not create a dedicated handoff artifact merely because QA is next.
Do not pre-populate a QA verdict.

input.prompt: Implementation is reviewed and complete, but the receiving QA runtime cannot access the canonical work store and needs bounded continuation state to proceed safely.

invariants.criterion: A dedicated handoff is allowed because a real runtime/persistence continuation boundary prevents safe reconstruction.

input.prompt: Implement an approved formatter change. The repository already has a canonical helper used by sibling callers whose contract fully satisfies the requirement.

invariants.criterion: Reuse the existing canonical helper and keep proportionate proof; progressive disclosure must not weaken Engineering Economy behavior.
